purpose: Lossless distribution of the exact historical synthetic native-projection proof; no new execution or approval.
reason: The Codex tool IPC frame is limited to 64 MiB; escaping the uncompressed proof exceeds it. The gzip preserves every original byte.
inspection: Decompress the .json.gz to its original .json filename to inspect the historical raw proof. The original historical harness still generates that original raw filename normally.
limits: This is packaging of existing test output, not a new native run, source-placement approval, complete route-closure proof, human acceptance, or learner-state evidence.
